title: WEB DEVELOPMENT
description: Interactive e-commerce web storefronts, highly custom Shopify models, and next-gen portfolios.
body: Building futuristic, ultra-fast web applications, custom e-commerce storefronts, 3D WebGL interactive experiences, and content-managed portals. Optimized for 100/100 Lighthouse performance, mobile responsiveness, seamless SEO, and headless CMS integrations.
benefits: Sub-second page loading speeds and lightning fast navigation
Full responsive design matching all desktop and mobile displays
Built-in SEO metadata, OpenGraph cards, and schema tags

process.desc: Map user journeys, data schemas, component tree, and responsive grid layouts.
Design dark futuristic UI components, glassmorphism panels, and smooth Framer Motion animations.
Develop type-safe React code, connect CMS hooks, and build API endpoints.
Optimize bundle sizes, audit accessibility, test mobile touch gestures, and deploy to Cloudflare Pages / Vercel.

deliverables: Configured Decap / Sanity / Headless CMS Admin Portal
